jobs.title: Oracle Fusion HCM Time & Labor Fast Formula Developer – AI-Assisted Delivery (Freelance, Europe)
jobs.description: Our international client is currently implementing Oracle Fusion HCM Time and Labor across multiple countries. The initial country implementation provides the foundation for subsequent rollouts. A large amount of Fast Formulas and country-specific adaptations must be developed, configured and validated within a demanding delivery schedule. We are looking for a hands-on Oracle Fusion HCM Time & Labor specialist who personally develops, modifies, tests and troubleshoots Fast Formulas . This is not a general Oracle HCM functional consulting, project management or solution architecture assignment. Framework Conditions Start: ASAP Duration: 4 months Capacity: 20-40 hours per week Location: Remote (Europe) Language: English Level: Senior Contract Type: Freelance Tasks Independently develop, modify, compile and troubleshoot Oracle Fusion HCM Time & Labor Fast Formulas. Convert clock-in/clock-out data and time card entries into payroll-relevant time elements and quantities for downstream payroll processing. Configure Time Calculation Rules, Time Entry Rules, Time Categories, Time Consumer Sets, eligibility conditions and related OTL functionality. Implement working-time calculations covering shift premiums, night work, weekends, public holidays, meal allowances, unpaid breaks and country-specific labor rules. Support complex manufacturing shift environments, flexible work schedules and multiple time capture methods, including Web Clock, external systems and manual entries. Reuse existing Oracle seeded formulas, customer-developed formulas and standardized calculation patterns wherever appropriate. jobs.title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops)
jobs.description: StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care. Supported by a Germany (ZIM) and Taiwanese (GIPIP) partnership grant, we are currently developing ARAIAS — an AR- and AI-based hands-free training and assistance system for chronic wound care. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care. As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings. As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment. We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain. Notes: Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany. Tasks Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models

We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), and London. The Role Validating conventional silicon is a solved discipline. Validating silicon that computes with noise is not, and you will be the one who figures out how. As our FPGA Design Engineer, you will own the bridge between RTL and physical silicon: bringing our physics-inspired ASIC designs to life on FPGA platforms for pre-silicon validation and early software development, and building the test infrastructure for post-silicon bring-up and characterization. Your scope spans the entire FPGA lifecycle: selecting hardware platforms, implementing complex RTL, debugging in the lab, and writing the software that drives it all, working daily with our silicon, EDA, and research teams. RTL Implementation : Adapt and implement complex ASIC RTL onto FPGA targets, including multi-clock-domain architectures, CDC bridges, and timing closure on dense designs. IP Integration : Integrate in-house designs with third-party and vendor IP; serve as the expert on the AMD/Xilinx ecosystem (Vivado IP Integrator, transceivers, memory controllers). High-Speed Interfaces : Design, implement, and validate high-speed I/O with a focus on PCIe: our accelerators ship as PCIe cards in standard servers. jobs.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. jobs.title: Thermal Engineer
jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role We are looking for a skilled Thermal Engineer with experience in spacecraft thermal management at both the subsystem and spacecraft level. You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team - including mechanical, propulsion, electronics, and mission planning - to ensure reliable thermal performance of our satellite throughout all mission phases: from launch to operation in orbit and end-of-life. You should be capable of delivering a thermal control system from scratch and taking full ownership of it, ensuring the success of our mission. Key Responsibilities Perform steady-state and transient thermal analysis of the spacecraft across all mission phases (TVAC testing, launch, orbit). Model and validate heat management strategies in the harsh environment of vacuum, where conduction and radiation are dominant Identify and manage worst-case scenarios in extreme thermal conditions (both hot and cold), accounting for on-orbit environmental factors and internal power dissipation Design and implement thermal control solutions such as multilayer insulation (MLI), radiators, heaters, thermo-optical coatings, thermistors, and thermal straps Develop and support thermal vacuum (TVAC) test procedures, instrumentation setup, and post-test data analysis. Be hands on in hardware testing for validation of processes, instrumentation, and materials and components chosen for in house development

jobs.title: Founders Associate Intern
jobs.description: Join Ark at an exciting stage and learn first-hand how a startup is built. Ark builds platforms for public administrations. We entered the market about a year ago with our best-known tool, a platform for local climate action, and now work with more than 60 cities, counties and states, from Schleswig-Holstein, Munich and Berlin to small rural municipalities. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised €2.4 million in pre-seed and grant funding and are approaching €1 million in annual revenue. As our Founders Associate Intern (all genders), you work side by side with our Chief of Staff Lennart, who is your day-to-day lead, and team up with our founder & CEO Ruth on selected projects. Your week has two halves. In the mornings you are part of our growth team and help win new public administrations as customers. This is the core of the role. In the afternoons you work with Lennart on whatever matters most for the company at that moment, from strategy and finance to HR and company initiatives. You will see from the inside how a fast-growing GovTech startup wins customers, makes decisions and builds its team. If you are thinking about founding your own company one day, there are few better places to learn. Tasks Joining Ark as a Founders Associate Intern means a new mix of topics every week. Here is a range of potential challenges: Growth: Spend your mornings with our sales team. Research and reach out to municipalities, qualify leads, book meetings and prepare customer conversations. You learn how public sector sales work and see your impact in our pipeline every week. You'll receive a bonus for each qualified demo booked. Strategy: Work with Lennart on strategic questions, prepare analyses and decision papers for management and turn decisions into concrete next steps. Company Initiatives: Take full ownership of projects that move Ark forward, from preparing and hosting webinars for municipalities to legal and administrative topics a growing company has to get right

jobs.title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
jobs.description: wo- afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten? Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. Je gaat onder andere: bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren. Het dashboard Verhuisketens in Nederland toont onder meer de gemiddelde lengte van een verhuisketen. Er is echter nog veel ruimte voor verdieping. Tijdens deze stage kun je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de rol van ouderenwoningen in de doorstroom op de huizenmarkt. Je kunt daarin op zoek gaan naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: In hoeverre draagt het bouwen van ouderenwoningen bij aan de doorstroom op de woningmarkt? Wat is de invloed van vergrijzing en overlijden van ouderen op de doorstroom en het woningaanbod? Heb je zelf een goede onderzoeksvraag die aansluit bij dit thema, dan is daar ook ruimte voor. You build, coach and lead a team of 6–8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it. What you'll do Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there. Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative. Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand. Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs. Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed. Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you. Who you are You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling. You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership. You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal. You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team. You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook. Building a team excites you more than your own quota. This might not be the right fit if… you'd prefer

jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.description: About Peec AI AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. The role Almost everything Peec shows a customer passes through a model at some point. We track brands, products, sentiment, citations and sources across millions of AI answers. Those answers change whenever a provider ships a new model and differ by country, language and prompt. Turning that into numbers customers can trust and act on is the core data science problem at Peec. Our data science team has grown fast, with AI-powered features shipping across the product. We're now growing the team further and need someone to lead it. You'll turn a group of strong individual contributors into a high-powered, fast-shipping team. You'll report directly to the CTO and lead a team of 7 data scientists. What you'll do Leading people Hire, onboard and grow the data science team. We're hiring several data scientists right now, and you'll shape who joins and how they ramp up. Build a team culture that matches our values: a high bar for quality, full ownership of outcomes, and kindness towards each other Lead and inspire the team through regular 1:1s, actionable feedback and clear career paths Leading the technical work Set the technical direction and roadmap for data science, together with product and engineering leadership, and decide what

jobs.title: Senior Property Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Über Buena Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Leuten im HQ zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden. Über die Rolle Du kennst den Alltag einer Hausverwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Verantwortlichkeiten unklar sind. Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an. Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen, und du überführst sie in den Buena-Betrieb. Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen und in Teams, die mit der Buena App besser arbeiten als vorher. Verantwortlichkeiten Du arbeitest im Tagesgeschäft unserer Verwaltungen mit, erkennst Engpässe früh und baust Rückstände ab. Vor und nach der Umstellung auf die Buena App. Du schaffst mit den Teams klare Zuständigkeiten und Prozesse, die auch nach deinem Einsatz Bestand haben. Du kennst unsere Software in- und auswendig und trainierst die Teams an ihren konkreten Aufgaben. Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag zurück ins Product-Team. Was du vor Ort siehst, macht unsere App besser. Du passt gut, wenn du Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst. Probleme schnell erkennst, Prioritäten setzt und selbst mit anpackst. Klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen aufbaust und Menschen für neue Arbeitsweisen gewinnst. Tech-affin bist. Neue Software lernst du schnell und erklärst sie so, dass anderen die Arbeit leichter fällt. Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Eins

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth. We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work. Position Overview We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows. You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows. In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction. The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions. This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious. About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town. Institutions can only get value from AMBOSS if their users can reach it easily and know it’s available to them, and as our Customer Success - Access Operations Specialist, you are the person who makes that happen. You’ll play a key role in ensuring our institutional partners unlock the full value of AMBOSS, helping embed it into daily clinical and teaching routines and strengthening user experience, retention, and growth. jobs.description: Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.” Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why Systems at AMBOSS? AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care. Why can this position be exciting for you? You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. jobs.title: Senior Fleet Manager
jobs.description: Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder! Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren. Wat ga je doen? In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Met ons label AirportPartners beheren wij hier de unieke en bedrijfskritische vloot van Schiphol: van de brandweerwagens en de onmisbare sneeuwvloot tot de personenwagens van het KLM-personeel. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership. Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers: Datagedreven Regie & Strategie: Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses; Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Vooruitdenken is jouw tweede natuur; Bewaking van SLA’s en KPI’s: Je monitort continu de prestaties, stuurt bij waar nodig en garandeert dat we onze beloftes aan de klant waarmaken (of overtreffen); Rapportage en overleg: Je zit regelmatig aan tafel met het management van klanten en leveranciers. Je presenteert heldere rapportages en treedt op als een volwaardig en strategisch gesprekspartner. Ope

jobs.title: Go-To-Market Associate
jobs.description: About us Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable teams to capture, automate, and integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle. We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2026 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board! About the role We're looking for an exceptional Go-To-Market Associate who will be the engine of our commercial team. As part of the top 1% of Commercial talents globally, you'll combine systematic prospecting with creative outreach to build relationships with decision-makers who need AI solutions. This is not a classic sales role. We're looking for a builder with a commercial brain and an enormous drive, someone who combines hustle, strategic creativity, and genuine curiosity about what makes businesses tick. You might come from a classic sales background, or you might have built your commercial instincts in a completely different arena. What matters far more than your CV is your drive, your entrepreneurial instinct, and the kind of work ethic that makes people wonder how you get so much done. In a single day you might: map a new industry vertical for outreach opportunities, run a consultative discovery call with a Head of Operations at a manufacturing company, develop a proposal for a new channel, follow up on an active deal in scoping, and draft a business case for entering a completely new market. You won't have a large team behind you. You will have full autonomy, meaningful equity, direct access to the founding team, and the freedom to experiment with what works. Why Lleverage?

jobs.description: Intégrez le Département Hydrogéologie du Groupe Fondasol et mettez votre expertise au service de projets innovants alliant technique et développement durable. Pour accompagner notre équipe, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Hydrogéologue F/H pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénieurs. Vos missions au quotidien En tant qu' Ingénieur Hydrogéologue , vous piloterez des projets d'aménagement et de gestion des eaux souterraines, de l'étude initiale à la présentation des résultats pour tous types de projets ( espaces publics, bâtiments industriels, tertiaires, résidentiels, ouvrages souterrains, etc.) . Vos missions consisteront à : Elaborer des devis en tenant compte des besoins de votre client Mener/piloter des campagnes de terrain pour l’acquisition des caractéristiques géologiques et hydrogéologiques de sites (essai de pompage, essai d’infiltration, traçages, prélèvements d’échantillons, etc.) en lien avec les Technicien Multi-Métiers. Réaliser des études en lien avec les eaux souterraines pour des projets variés comme l’estimation des niveaux caractéristiques de nappe, le calcul des débits de pompage/épuisement en phase travaux, le suivi de travaux de rabattement, , les problématiques de gestion des eaux pluviales, les études géothermiques (aquathermie et champ de sondes), etc. Concevoir des solutions techniques pour la gestion des eaux comme par exemple, des systèmes de rabattement de nappe, puits d’infiltration ou de recharge, bassins de rétention et ou infiltration d’eaux pluviales, ou encore des systèmes de drainage. Rédiger des rapports techniques et présenter vos conclusions aux équipes de projets (MOA/MOE/AMO) et autorités (DREAL, DDT(M)). Travailler en synergie avec les expertises du Groupe (géotechniques, environnementales, géophysiques, …) pour proposer des offres complètes et identifier de nouvelles opportunités. Contribuez développement commercial en proposant l’ensemble de nos expertises et solutions innovantes en hydrogéologie, géothermie et stockage de déche

Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement. jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Introductie Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten? Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Product Manager die verantwoordelijk is voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie. In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek. Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven. Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen

jobs.title: HR stagiair Learning & Development (meewerkstage)
jobs.description: Wil jij tijdens je stage echt meedraaien en ontdekken hoe leren en ontwikkelen werkt in de praktijk? Bij DPD Nederland in Oirschot krijg je als HR stagiair Learning & Development de kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een professioneel én toegankelijk L&D‑team. Je werkt samen met ervaren specialisten en leert hoe trainingen en e‑learning bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van medewerkers. Lees verder en ontdek of deze stage bij jou past. Wat ga je doen? Je komt in het Learning & Development team van DPD Nederland. Dit team bestaat uit de Manager Talent Acquisition & Development en twee Learning & Development specialisten en is onderdeel van afdeling HR, waar ruim 20 collega’s werken. Je krijgt goede begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en leert vooral door te doen. Geen stagedag is hetzelfde. Dit ga je leren en doen: Meewerken met het leermanagementsysteem (LMS), zoals het bouwen en verbeteren van online cursussen. Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van leerprogramma’s en trainingen. Meedenken over creatieve en vernieuwende manieren van leren, online én offline. Helpen bij het inventariseren van leerbehoeften van medewerkers. Assisteren bij de organisatie van workshops, trainingen en e‑learningmodules. Leren hoe DPD investeert in persoonlijke ontwikkeling, innovatie en duurzame inzetbaarheid. Wat bieden we jou? Een stagevergoeding van €450 tot €550 bruto per maand. Dans le cadre du projet STRIKEER, qui vise à améliorer la robustesse des systèmes de réception GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems) vis-à-vis du brouillage et du leurrage, nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant au sein de notre département MEE (Mathematical and Electrical Engineering). En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet, la société ARKANE et ArianeGroup, vous aurez pour mission principale de convertir les traitements hybrides IA/DSP développés dans le projet en versions embarquables sur FPGA. Vous intégrerez et optimiserez une architecture hybride IA/DSP temps réel sur FPGA Zynq UltraScale+, en tenant compte des contraintes SWaP (taille, poids, consommation) des systèmes embarqués sur drones et lanceurs. Enfin, vous validerez sur cible les traitements embarqués (FPGA-In-the-Loop), implémenterez une première chaîne CRPA hybride complète et en assurerez la documentation, la traçabilité et la valorisation scientifique. Vous aimez travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire et vous avez d'excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale en français et en anglai

jobs.description: Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) Partenaires IMT impliqués : Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures, Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février): Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM) Description du projet : L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences. Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens. Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète. Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux. tags: liris - laboratoire d'informatique en image et systèmes d'information
jobs.description: PROJECT OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure

Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally. We re looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about  life at Dashlane , including how we work , how we hire , and the benefits of being a Dashlaner .   About the role As our Staff Product Manager for Agentic Capabilities, you will own the vision, strategy and roadmap for how Dashlane becomes an interface for AI agents and assistants for consumers and businesses. We are looking for strong familiarity with the modern AI landscape, including LLMs, assistants and agentic workflows, and sound judgment about what agents can and cannot be trusted with. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 17 tahun 1968, BNI ditetapkan menjadi “Bank Negara Indonesia 1946”, dan statusnya menjadi Bank Umum Milik Negara. jobs.description: We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems. You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines. We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7. This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval. jobs.title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
jobs.description: Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives. Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles. Pourquoi ce recrutement ? Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas. Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence. Missions Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes. 1. Enquêter Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs. Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A . 2. Dévoiler Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an. Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites . Trouver les angle

jobs.title: Stage Community management (H/F/X) - Lyon
jobs.description: Handicap International (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 59 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons 4000 employés dans le monde. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens. Au sein de l’équipe communication de Handicap International France, vous participerez au développement et à l’animation des communautés de l’organisation sur les réseaux sociaux (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, etc.), en lien étroit avec le community manager et le social media manager. Vous contribuerez à faire vivre les échanges avec les internautes, à identifier les sujets susceptibles de susciter leur intérêt et à adapter les prises de parole de l’association aux usages des différentes plateformes. Vous participerez à la recherche de nouvelles idées éditoriales, à la conception de formats adaptés aux réseaux sociaux et à la valorisation des actions de l’organisation auprès du grand public. Vous prendrez également part à la préparation et à la coordination de la diffusion des publications, ainsi qu’à une veille sur les tendances numériques, les conversations en ligne et les initiatives d’autres acteurs du secteur.

jobs.title: Agent Security Engineer
jobs.description: Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing. You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence. Requirements 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP) Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar) Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: ABOUT CIVILGRID CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running. We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for. WHY THIS ROLE We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team. This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired. Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, youâll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include: Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy As a Senior Backend Engineer , you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo. About You 7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products Product acumen to reason about technical tradeoffs in terms of user impact Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks

Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

jobs.title: Graduate Transport Planner
jobs.description: At Curtins, we re an employee-owned engineering consultancy driven by a simple ambition: to create a better built environment for everyone. For over 65 years, we ve delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. From major regeneration schemes and commercial developments to education, healthcare and residential projects, our work helps shape the places where people live, learn, work and thrive. As a Graduate Transport Planner, you ll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career. What you ll be doing You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval. Your responsibilities will include: Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. Analysing traffic, transport and movement data. Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies. Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations. Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects. What kind of projects will I get to work on? You ll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including: Residential developments. Urban regeneration schemes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Supply Chain Optimization: Continuously evaluate the supply chain processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. Risk Managemen
